title: Delivery status callbacks
note: BUG: message status is updated (delivered; failed with error 30008 kept in messages.wa_error), but no API or page shows delivery failures to the clinic — wa_status/wa_error are only read in lib/whatsapp.ts and lib/engine.ts (no reference under app/ or components/).

title: Templates outside 24 h
note: Needs a real Twilio account and approved templates delivered to an allowlisted test phone; with the fake credentials any allowlisted send would hit api.twilio.com. Template choice logic (lib/whatsapp.ts hold()) not exercised end to end.

title: Buttons
note: Needs a real Twilio account (Content API button resources are created on send, lib/twilio.ts buttonsContent).

title: Long message split
note: Needs a real Twilio send to observe the split parts (lib/whatsapp.ts splitText/sendSession).

title: Stranger
note: PLAN: polite reply sent, nothing revealed, body not stored — but nothing is "logged for the clinic": only timestamps are kept (wa:lastin:+919000088888, wa:stranger:whatsapp:+919000088888) and no page lists unknown senders. By design (app/api/twilio/inbound/route.ts:22 "only the time they wrote is kept").

title: No health data in logs
note: checked 632 bytes of server logs (demo + live) for message bodies/readings; none found
